newsitem.title: USA: Veritas DGC buys assets of co.
newsitem.headline: Veritas DGC buys assets of co.

text.p: Veritas DGC Inc said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire substantially all of the assets of Rees Geophysical Oman LLC.
Under the agreement, which is effective June 1, Veritas is buying two Sercel SN 388 land seismic data acquisition systems equipped with 2,400 channels of recording equipment.
Also part of the deal are 18 AMG P23 all-terrain buggy vibrator units as well as all support vehicles and camps.

Veritas said the Rees purchase supports the Company's objective to expand its product lines in selected geographic markets globally and offers an economical opportunity to provide land data acquisition services in the Middle East.
Veritas provides land, transition zone and marine-based seismic data acquisition, seismic data processing and multi-client data sales to the petroleum industry.
